constraints.name: avatar_media_identity
constraints.definition:
CHECK (business_scope <> 'avatar'::text OR provider = 'r2'::text AND bucket = 'locally-public-avatars'::text AND parent_type = 'profile_avatar'::text AND parent_id IS NOT NULL AND parent_id = owner_id::text AND public_url IS NOT NULL AND expected_size <= 10485760 AND (mime = ANY (ARRAY['image/jpeg'::text, 'image/png'::text, 'image/webp'::text, 'image/gif'::text, 'image/avif'::text])) AND object_key = ((((('avatars/v1/'::text || encode(sha256(convert_to('avatar-media-owner:'::text || owner_id::text, 'UTF8'::name)), 'hex'::text)) || '/'::text) || id::text) || '/avatar.'::text) ||
CASE mime
    WHEN 'image/jpeg'::text THEN 'jpg'::text
    ELSE substr(mime, 7)
END) AND public_url = ('https://avatars-media.locally-travel.com/'::text || object_key))

constraints.name: media_assets_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (state <> 'committed'::text OR verified_at IS NOT NULL AND committed_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: media_assets_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (state <> 'tombstoned'::text OR tombstoned_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: media_assets_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (business_scope <> 'experience'::text OR expected_size <= 10485760 AND provider = 'r2'::text AND bucket = 'locally-public-experience-canary'::text AND object_key ~~ 'sources/v1/experience/%'::text AND public_url = ('https://media-canary.locally-travel.com/'::text || object_key))

constraints.name: media_deletion_journal_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (state <> 'complete'::text OR object_deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)
